purpose: Rank source-supported secondary human-review routes by direct assessment reuse and cross-track value after the Core 12 wave.
boundary: Priority changes review order only. It never changes page verification, indexing, status, factual-review state, or publication policy.

scoring_rule.direct_case_reuse: 4 points per published case whose human_refs include the route
scoring_rule.case_track_breadth: 3 points per distinct assessment track among those direct published cases
scoring_rule.catalog_track_reuse: 2 points per catalog track that lists the route as an entry point
scoring_rule.source_supported_claims: 1 point per source-supported reviewed claim, capped at 4
scoring_rule.tie_break: higher direct case count, then route name
